description: This file defines the HtmlMenuWrapper class, which provides functionality to initialize, render, and manage context for HTML menus within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with menu models, renders menu strings, and manages request, response, and session data.

classes.name: HtmlMenuWrapper
classes.description: A class that manages the initialization, rendering, and context handling for HTML menus in the OFBiz framework, allowing dynamic menu rendering and state management.

methods.name: HtmlMenuWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HtmlMenuWrapper with resource, menu name, request, and response objects.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with resource name, menu name, request, and response, and sets up the model menu, renderer, and context.

methods.name: getMenuRenderer
methods.description: Returns a new instance of HtmlMenuRenderer for rendering the menu.

methods.name: renderMenuString
methods.description: Renders the menu to a string using the model menu and current context.

methods.name: setIsError
methods.description: Sets the error state in the context.

methods.name: getIsError
methods.description: Returns whether the current context has an error state.

methods.name: setMenuOverrideName
methods.description: Overrides the menu name in the context.

methods.name: putInContext
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the context.

methods.name: putInContext
methods.description: Adds a menu item-specific key-value pair to the context.

methods.name: getFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the context by name.

methods.name: getFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a menu item and key from the context.

methods.name: getModelMenu
methods.description: Returns the model menu object.

methods.name: getRenderer
methods.description: Returns the current menu renderer.

methods.name: setRenderer
methods.description: Sets the menu renderer.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the HTTP request object and updates the renderer accordingly.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object and updates the renderer accordingly.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request from the renderer.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP response from the renderer.

methods.name: getMenuWrapper
methods.description: Static method to retrieve or create an HtmlMenuWrapper from session or instantiate a new one based on class name, request, response, and session.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets the parameter map in the context.
